title: E-commerce & Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**We are hiring!** 




**E\-commerce \& Digital Marketing Executive \| Aluva** 




  





 Looking for a part\-time or Fulltime executive who is interested in building hands\-on experience in E\-commerce, Digital Marketing and Online Business Growth.
 



  





 You’ll work from my office in Aluva and take responsibility for managing our e\-commerce activities while supporting the digital marketing and growth of the business.
 



  





**What You’ll Work On** 




**E\-commerce Management** 



* Manage products, listings, pricing and inventory on our online platforms
* Process and coordinate online orders
* Monitor order status, fulfilment and customer updates
* Maintain product information, images and content



  





**Digital Marketing \& Social Media** 



* Manage social media pages and regular content updates
* Create and publish posts, reels and promotional content
* Support digital campaigns and online promotions
* Assist with basic SEO, lead generation and website updates
* Track engagement, enquiries and campaign performance



  





**Business \& Operations Support** 



* Coordinate with suppliers for product availability and pricing
* Assist with purchasing and stock updates
* Coordinate local deliveries and order fulfilment when required
* Handle customer enquiries and follow\-ups



  





**Business Growth** 




 \- Explore marketplaces and online sales opportunities
 



 \- Support seasonal campaigns and product launches
 



 \- Identify practical ways to increase online sales and customer reach
 



  





 You don’t need extensive experience. Freshers and candidates with relevant experience are welcome.
 



  





**What matters more is:** 



* Willingness to learn and take initiative
* Basic understanding of social media and digital platforms
* Interest in e\-commerce and online business
* Good communication and follow\-up skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership
* A practical, hands\-on approach to getting things done



  





 This is not a purely desk\-based social media role. You’ll get practical exposure to how an online business actually works — from product listing and marketing to orders, customers, suppliers and sales.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Aluva, Kerala
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Part\-time / Full\-Time from office
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers / Experienced candidates
 



**Domain:** 
 E\-commerce \| Digital Marketing \| Online Business Growth
 



  





 If you’re looking for an opportunity where you can learn, contribute and gain real\-world experience in building an online business, let’s talk.
 



  





 Interested? Send me your CV/profile with a short introduction about yourself to
 **cleverjack.in@gmail.com**

title: Digital Marketing Trainer
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 IBARC (Integrated Business Automation Research Centre) is dedicated to researching business growth strategies, tools, and innovative solutions aimed at empowering SMEs and start\-ups. Our goal is to provide the resources and techniques necessary for businesses to achieve sustainable growth and scalability. We are committed to fostering innovation and delivering impactful results, ensuring that our clients are equipped to meet the challenges of a competitive market. By addressing the unique needs of SMEs and start\-ups, we contribute to their success and long\-term development.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Digital Marketing Trainer based in Ernakulam. The Digital Marketing Trainer will be responsible for creating and delivering high\-quality training programs on digital marketing strategies and tools. Day\-to\-day tasks include preparing training materials, conducting interactive sessions, mentoring trainees, evaluating their progress, and staying updated with the latest digital marketing trends and technologies. This role also involves collaborating with the team to enhance training methodologies and ensuring that learners have the necessary skills and knowledge to succeed.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong knowledge of Digital Marketing concepts, including SEO, SEM, Social Media Marketing, and Email Marketing
* AI and Automation expertise is required
* Proficiency in Web Analytics, Content Strategy, and online advertising platforms
* Experience in Training, Curriculum Development, and creating instructional materials
* Strong Presentation, Communication, and Public Speaking skills
* Adaptability to evaluate and mentor trainees based on their individual needs
* Ability to stay updated with current trends and advancements in Digital Marketing
* Relevant certifications in Digital Marketing and/or Training are a plus
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, or a related field is preferred

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
**Svntytoo Pixels LLP** 
 values innovation, accountability, and a culture of continuous learning, providing opportunities for professionals to develop their skills and contribute meaningful ideas.
 



**Role Description** 
 This full\-time Marketing Specialist role is a hybrid position based in Kerala, India, with flexibility for some work\-from\-home days. The Marketing Specialist will plan and execute marketing campaigns, support brand positioning, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across channels. Daily responsibilities include conducting market research, analyzing customer behavior and competitor activity, assisting with sales and promotional initiatives, and monitoring campaign performance. The role also includes preparing marketing materials and presentations, collaborating with design and content teams, and maintaining strong communication with clients and stakeholders. The Marketing Specialist is expected to contribute ideas for improving marketing strategy and enhancing customer engagement while meeting agreed timelines and performance targets.
 


**Qualifications**




* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, colleagues, and stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Market Research and Marketing Strategy skills, including the ability to analyze data, identify trends, and support strategic planning.
* Candidates should possess Sales and customer relationship skills to assist with lead generation, follow\-ups, and supporting sales campaigns.
* Candidates should ideally have familiarity with digital marketing tools, social media platforms, and basic analytics (e.g., Google Analytics or similar).
* Relevant educational background in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Prior experience in a marketing or advertising environment is beneficial, especially within creative or design\-focused organizations.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
We're looking for a hands\-on Marketing Coordinator who's equally comfortable out in the field and behind a phone. This is a hybrid role: part of your week is spent on the ground, managing distribution of flyers, running local activations, and talking to real customers, and part is spent building our presence online through social media and local influencers. If you like variety, you're organized, and you're motivated by seeing your work turn into actual foot traffic and followers, this is for you.
 



 What you'll do
 



**On the ground** 



* Plan and run door\-to\-door and local flyer campaigns, and identify the neighborhoods, spots, and events worth targeting
* Represent the brand at pop\-ups, local events, and community activations
* Track which locations and tactics actually drive traffic, and adjust based on what's working



**Social \& influencer** 



* Find, reach out to, and manage relationships with local micro\-influencers and content creators
* Coordinate posts, collaborations, and content, including negotiating small paid or barter deals
* Help create and schedule content across our social channels
* Monitor reach, engagement, and results, and report back on what's landing



 What we're looking for
 


* Comfortable being out in the field and starting conversations with strangers
* Organized enough to juggle multiple campaigns, creators, and deadlines at once
* Social\-media savvy, with a feel for what makes local content perform
* Numbers\-aware, you can tell us what's working and what isn't
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel locally
* 1\+ years in marketing, promotions, sales, or a related area is a plus (but we'll consider the right hustler without it)



 Nice to have
 


* Experience with influencer outreach or managing brand ambassadors
* Basic content creation skills (photo, short video, simple graphics)
* Familiarity with tools like \[Instagram/TikTok, Canva, scheduling tools, etc.]
